meta.source: Reconciled from the Notion 'ETA Design System (Claude Design): Token and Component Inventory' (2026-10-06), the era-app index.css and the Investor Pitch Template deck. Brand Evolution 12 (board supplied by Erik Hanzlick, 2026-10-14, 'as canon as it gets for now') replaces Brand Evolution 06 and the Royal Blue direction: Emerald leads, Sapphire marks the digital layer, Ruby sits only in the mark, Forest is the dark ground. Hexes for Ruby, Emerald, Sapphire, Forest, Sage and Paper are read from the board; accent-strong, accent-tint, the dark-theme values and the reversed mark faces are derived and flagged in their notes. The mono family resolves to Inter. Brand Evolution 13 (board and four reference sheets supplied by Erik Hanzlick, 2026-10-14) replaces Evolution 12: it adds White #F7F7F4, Obsidian #111214, Silver #B9BEC4 and Gold #B79A58 (hexes read from the board), returns the dark ground to Obsidian, and leaves Forest, Sage and Paper off the board. Those three stay as tokens for existing material.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Always set per section. Paper #FBFAF9 from Evolution 12; the Evolution 13 canon ground is the white token (#F7F7F4).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Secondary panel, tag and band fill, one step off paper.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Elevated cards and table bodies on paper or surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, card borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, surface and card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary body text on paper, surface and card.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Footers, page numbers, source lines. Not for anything read closely.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Emerald (#12664F), the brand voice of the Brand Evolution 12 canon: fills, buttons, big numerals, links and section labels at 24px and up. Text under 24px uses accent-strong.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Emerald for text under 24px on paper, surface or card (9.14:1 light, 9.53:1 dark). Derived darker and lighter from the canon Emerald.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-fill (buttons and small labels, 6.91:1 light, 7.27:1 dark). On accent itself it passes at any size now.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Emerald fill behind on-accent text under 24px (primary Button): 6.91:1 light, 7.27:1 dark. Equals accent now that Emerald carries white text; kept as its own token so components do not change.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Pill, tag and callout fill behind accent-strong text (8.19:1 light). Derived pale tint of Emerald; not a canon swatch.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Bullion and ceremonial accent: gold Badge tone and the right face of the ceremonial gold mark (on band-dark). Decorative. This is the bright bullion gold (#EEB32B); the Evolution 13 canon Gold is the muted gold-canon (#B79A58). Do not pair with Ruby, Sapphire or Emerald in the mark.

tokens.name: letter-e
tokens.usage: The E of ETA in the wordmark only. Legacy: the proposed mark of 2026-10-09 does not use the letter colours; keep for legacy material until the logo is ratified.

tokens.name: letter-t
tokens.usage: The T of ETA in the wordmark only. Legacy: the proposed mark of 2026-10-09 does not use the letter colours; keep for legacy material until the logo is ratified.

tokens.name: letter-a
tokens.usage: The A of ETA in the wordmark only. Legacy: the proposed mark of 2026-10-09 does not use the letter colours; keep for legacy material until the logo is ratified.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending or caution status text. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocked or failed status text. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text placed on a gold fill (the gold Badge tone). Dark in both themes because ink inverts in the dark theme and would fail on gold. Added 2026-10-08.

tokens.name: mark-facet-light
tokens.usage: Left face of the mark: Ruby in the light theme. The token name is legacy (it was the lit blue face); the position is what matters. In the mark only. This is the middle tone of the face; the Logo component and the SVG files derive the lit, shaded and deep facets from it.

tokens.name: mark-facet-mid
tokens.usage: Right face of the mark: Sapphire in the light theme. In the mark only. This is the middle tone of the face; the Logo component and the SVG files derive the lit, shaded and deep facets from it.

tokens.name: mark-facet-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom face of the mark: Emerald in the light theme. In the mark only; also a cover block. This is the middle tone of the face; the Logo component and the SVG files derive the lit, shaded and deep facets from it.

tokens.name: mark-reversed-light
tokens.usage: Left face (Ruby, lifted) of the mark on band-dark, in either theme. Derived: the canon Ruby falls to 2.30:1 on Obsidian; this is 6.85:1. This is the middle tone of the face; the Logo component and the SVG files derive the lit, shaded and deep facets from it.

tokens.name: mark-reversed-mid
tokens.usage: Right face (Sapphire, lifted) of the mark on band-dark, in either theme (7.39:1 on Obsidian). Derived. This is the middle tone of the face; the Logo component and the SVG files derive the lit, shaded and deep facets from it.

tokens.name: mark-reversed-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom face (Emerald, lifted) of the mark on band-dark, in either theme (8.71:1 on Obsidian); a cropped mark on banners. Derived. This is the middle tone of the face; the Logo component and the SVG files derive the lit, shaded and deep facets from it.

tokens.name: band-dark
tokens.usage: Background, not text: Obsidian (#111214) in both themes, the dark ground of Brand Evolution 13. Behind the reversed logo, the tagline plate, the business-card back, the builder panel, the booklet cover, avatars and statement bands. Text on it is on-band-dark (17.02:1) or on-band-dark-muted (9.68:1). It was Forest (#244B3E) under Brand Evolution 12 and a near-black ink band before that; the Forest swatch stays as the forest token.

tokens.name: on-band-dark
tokens.usage: Text and one-colour logo on band-dark.

tokens.name: on-band-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on band-dark.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Lit face of the ceremonial gold mark. On band-dark only, never beside blue.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Shadow face of the ceremonial gold mark. On band-dark only, never beside blue.

tokens.name: ruby
tokens.usage: Canon swatch Ruby (#9B1738). The left face of the mark. Do not use as a UI or text color.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Canon swatch Emerald (#12664F). The mark's bottom face; the accent token carries it in the interface.

tokens.name: sapphire
tokens.usage: Canon swatch Sapphire (#153E8A). The mark's right face. In the interface the digital token carries it.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Evolution 12 swatch Forest (#244B3E), not on the Evolution 13 board. Kept so existing material resolves; band-dark now carries Obsidian. New work does not use it.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Evolution 12 swatch Sage (#91AD91), not on the Evolution 13 board. Decorative: map linework, dividers, wireframes. Never text on paper (2.3:1). New work prefers silver and gold-canon linework.

tokens.name: digital
tokens.usage: The digital layer: tokenized-rights icons, token grids and principle numerals. Sapphire in the light theme (9.65:1 on paper), lifted in the dark (7.19:1). Always paired with a word or label.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Canon swatch White (#F7F7F4), Brand Evolution 13: the marble-white ground of boards, covers and card fronts. paper (#FBFAF9) stays the working page background; use white for brand boards and print.

tokens.name: obsidian
tokens.usage: Canon swatch Obsidian (#111214), Brand Evolution 13: the dark brand ground. band-dark carries it in the interface. Text on it is on-band-dark. Roles read from the board.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Canon swatch Silver (#B9BEC4), Brand Evolution 13: metal frames, rules, fine linework and the silver mark. Decorative: 10.02:1 on Obsidian, 1.74:1 on White, so never text on White.

tokens.name: gold-canon
tokens.usage: Canon swatch Gold (#B79A58), Brand Evolution 13: a muted brass gold for linework, rules, frames, token squares and principle numerals, thin or small only. 6.94:1 on Obsidian and 2.52:1 on White, so it never carries small text on White. Not the bullion gold (the gold token, #EEB32B).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading. The token says 11px but the component and specimens use 12px; this system adopts 12px.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Identifiers, serials, figures. Set in Inter with tabular numerals (Brand Evolution 06: Inter for headlines, body and data); the family key stays mono as the data role.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.usage: Primary slide body copy. Never below 24px on a slide.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows (uppercase, 4px tracking), footers, page numbers, captions.

styles.name: slide-stat
styles.usage: Big number on a stat card.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a component.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap, card padding on screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards on a slide.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between slide blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section gaps; footer offset on a slide.

tokens.name: margin-slide
tokens.usage: Left and right slide margin on a 1920x1080 canvas.

spacing.note: 4px is the working base unit in the Claude Design scale (space-1 here equals the project's space-2). The Style Guide says 8px; that is an open decision recorded in Notion.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and images (base 0.5rem).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels, slide cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, CTAs.
